verdict.rationale: Honeybadger exposes a REST API to list/retrieve fault (error) data in JSON (honeybadger-docs-19, honeybadger-docs-15) and Business/Enterprise plans can replicate Insights data out of the platform (honeybadger-docs-22), which gives some path to pulling data out in an open format. However there is no documented comprehensive 'export all my data' tool, no account-level data dump, and no explicit data-portability/deletion policy. Missing for 10: a full account/data export feature, documentation of exporting all data types (not just faults/Insights), and confirmation of open-format completeness for leaving the platform.
